name: Thaai Casting Ltd.
summary: Thaai Casting Ltd. is an automotive ancillary company specializing in precision aluminum die casting and comprehensive engineering solutions. The company's operations encompass High-Pressure Die Casting (HPDC), Low-Pressure Die Casting (LPDC), precision machining of both ferrous and non-ferrous materials, induction heating and quenching, gas nitriding, gear shaping, and heavy machining. They offer a diverse range of products including engine mounting support brackets, transmission mounts, steering wheel armatures, electrical connectors, engine and transmission parts, EV battery enclosures, steering assemblies, planetary gears, and windmill gearbox components. Thaai Casting primarily serves leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers in the automotive, electrical, and industrial sectors, following a B2B model with a focus on lightweighting solutions for both Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) and Electric Vehicles (EVs). The company also caters to non-automotive sectors such as wind energy and earth-moving vehicles, with plans for expanding into the aerospace industry and initiating exports.
